اسلنطحن (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْطَحْنَ (islanṭaḥna) /is.lan.tˤaħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# اِسْلَنْطِحْنَ (islanṭiḥna) /is.lan.tˤiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
